title: Ox Passion Strawberry Vanilla Ice Cream Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Strawberry Vanilla Ice Cream blends smooth Vanilla with the sweet, fruity flavour of ripe Strawberry for a creamy dessert-inspired vape. The Vanilla base delivers a soft, velvety richness, while the Strawberry adds a bright, summery sweetness. Together, they create a satisfying and indulgent flavour that’s perfect for fans of creamy, well-balanced e-liquids. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and infused with nicotine salts, this e-liquid offers smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine absorption. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits, it performs best in pod systems, starter pens, and other low-powered refillable devices. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, OX Passion Nic Salts offer bold, layered flavour profiles with a consistently smooth finish. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping hardware, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to pair seamlessly with Oxva XLIM pod kits and other refillable MTL vape devices.
